name: Preintegration LUT Generation
definition: A technique to generate a 2D lookup table (LUT) for volume rendering that pre-integrates color and opacity over a path length, reducing the number of samples needed during rendering. Supports two modes: 'medium' (Beer-Lambert approximation with average color) and 'particle' (standard front-to-back blending).
summary: Preintegration LUT Generation creates a 2D lookup table that pre-integrates color and opacity over a path length to reduce rendering samples, supporting distinct medium and particle modes.
